reason: The README describes an MCP server whose primary user-facing purpose is persistent, shared memory and context for AI assistants, including semantic retrieval, memory consolidation, relationship-based recall, and cross-client reuse. It also documents local file storage, automatic client configuration, and optional remote services, supporting an R2 risk classification.

summaries.zh: 通过 MCP 为多个 AI 助手提供可持久化、可检索并可跨会话共享的本地记忆与上下文。
summaries.en: An MCP server that provides persistent, searchable memory and context shared across AI assistants and sessions.

capabilities: import and export of external note directories
automatic modification of AI tool configuration files during setup
optional connections to remote servers and LLM APIs
